name: sonarqube-auth-action
description: Exchanges the GitHub Actions OIDC token for a short-lived, project-scoped SonarQube Cloud token (Workload Identity Federation).

scripts.build: esbuild src/main/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --sourcemap --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js
